status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Inlined into server.mjs by esbuild because neither is published: the engine is an unpublished candidate, and the comparison is TypeScript in the site repository. Bundling is what keeps one copy of the comparison rules rather than two.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned draft vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard.

changedSince: rc.1, rc.2 and rc.3 are unchanged and still downloadable; this is a separate immutable archive. Since rc.3 the executable bundle is byte-identical — this release corrects what the documents say about it. The README described a four-part rule for calling a cause reproduced, one part of which (a differing build claim refusing the replay) had already been removed, and quoted an explanation string the server no longer emits. It also said the baseline checks each record's cusps, when it checks cusps, angles and body positions. The corrected text states what is actually demonstrated: the installed engine reproduced these values from these declared inputs. Equal SemVer precedence is an ordering rule, not evidence that two builds run the same code, and nothing here authenticates a record's claims about itself in either direction.
